preamble: Fronting of the open back vowel [ɑ] and its merger with [a]. In Metropolitan French the phoneme /ɑ/ (pâte, tâche, mâle), which arose largely from /a/ before a lost /s/, has merged with /a/, and both are realized as central [ä], so that pâte sounds like patte and tâche like tache. The distinction is kept in Belgium, Switzerland, Quebec and Francophone Africa.
